body.message:
As per your request, please find the 6-month rates for The Bay

September: AED 8,500
October: AED 9,800
November: AED 11,500
December: AED 12,800
January : AED 11,500
February: AED 11,500

Please note that a security deposit of AED 2,000 is required. The booking will be on a monthly basis only (30 nights each month).

If you wish to lock the rate for 06 months we need to have 1st and last month rental in advance and the security deposit amount

Thank you.
